name: simplegrid-site
description: simplegrid.ai — static site. This file exists only so the tests under js/ have a runner and jsdom to run in; the site itself has no build step and ships as plain HTML, CSS and JS. _config.yml excludes package.json, package-lock.json and node_modules/ from what GitHub Pages serves.

scripts.test: for t in js/*.test.js; do printf '%-28s' "$(basename $t)"; node "$t" > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo PASS || { node "$t"; exit 1; }; done
